prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Sync Security Redesign: Redesign the sign-in options area to emphasize account cloud synchronization, preventing account resets and lost pet data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "text", "text": "Sign in to safely back up your desktop pet and sync progress across devices.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Basics Screen: Insert a new screen before completion showing desktop controls for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_basics", "home_intro"], "new_pet_basics": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Controls", "body": "Right click your pet anytime on the desktop to interact, feed, or minimize them to the tray.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Two Column Comparison Layout: Redesign the pet selection screen to a two-column layout comparing traits side-by-side to speed up decision-making.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Compare and Select Your Companion"}}
3: [home, new_flow] Background Rendering Notification Flow: Add an optional ready notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Alert Me When Pet Is Ready", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Onboarding Path Overview Screen: Add a path overview screen before selection to set clear expectations for the onboarding steps.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_overview": {"headline": "Your Companion Journey", "body": "In 3 simple steps, choose a companion, complete setup, and launch your pet directly onto your desktop.", "layout": "card"}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Requirement Hint: Add a photo requirement hint on the photo upload screen recommending clear lighting and unobstructed faces.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit photos with clear framing for best 3D pet rendering."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Launch Tip: Display a desktop launch tip on the waiting screen explaining how to locate the pet icon in the taskbar if it doesn't open immediately.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If the pet window does not open automatically, look for the app icon in your taskbar or system tray."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Story Goal Clarification Copy: Rephrase story copy to reassure users that companion options and behaviors can be changed later.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a starting companion path. You can customize behaviors and appearance anytime later in settings."}}
8: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Protection Badge: Add a cloud save security badge component above sign-in options to emphasize data retention.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Save Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, notification] System Tray Location Notification: Add a notification hint on home intro highlighting the system tray icon location for quick access.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Your desktop pet menu lives in the system tray for fast access anytime."}}

verdicts.reason: Replacing sign-in options with static text removes the functionality required to sign in, losing the screen's essential job.
Adding a new pet controls info screen inside onboarding is permitted and retains all required steps.
Redesigning the pick_friend layout to a two-column view retains the core job of letting the user select a pet.
Adding a ready alert button on the waiting screen stays within onboarding and maintains the waiting screen's purpose.
Inserting an overview screen before path selection is allowed inside onboarding and preserves all required steps.
Adding a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen is valid and does not break any rules.
Displaying a helpful launch tip on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Updating story text to clarify starting options maintains the story screen's job of introducing the pet.
Adding a cloud save badge component to the sign-in screen is permitted within onboarding.
Adding a system tray hint to home_intro is valid as home_intro is part of onboarding.
